rows.note: This is the everyday all-purpose choice for being financially obligated or owing someone money.

example.english: I don't want to be indebted anymore, so I'll pay off my credit-card bill when I get paid this month.
example.traditional: 我唔想再欠人錢，今個月出糧就還返張卡數。
example.jyutping: ngo5 m4 soeng2 zoi3 him3 jan4 cin2 gam1 go3 jyut6 ceot1 loeng4 zau6 waan4 faan1 zoeng1 kaa1 sou3

rows.note: Use this when you feel you owe someone gratitude or a return favour for what they have done.

example.english: You helped me find a job this time, and I'm really indebted to you.
example.traditional: 你今次幫我搵到份工，我真係欠人情㗎喇。
example.jyutping: nei5 gam1 ci3 bong1 ngo5 wan2 dou3 fan6 gung1 ngo5 zan1 hai6 him3 jan4 cing4 gaa3 laa3
